rows.name: mode
rows.source:
#define MODE DECL
#xcommand METHOD <x> => METHOD <x> MODE
#xcommand METHOD <x> DECL => OUT(<x>)
METHOD New

rows.name: mode_reversed
rows.source:
#define MODE DECL
#xcommand METHOD <x> DECL => OUT(<x>)
#xcommand METHOD <x> => METHOD <x> MODE
METHOD New

rows.name: macro_first
rows.source:
#define ALIAS METHOD
#xcommand METHOD <x> => OUT(<x>)
ALIAS New

rows.name: macro_each
rows.source:
#define NEXT SECOND
#xcommand FIRST <x> => NEXT <x>
#xcommand SECOND <x> => OUT(<x>)
FIRST New

rows.name: undef_guard
rows.source:
#define MODE DECL
#xcommand FIRST => #undef MODE ; MODE
FIRST
MODE

rows.name: embedded_undef
rows.source:
#define MODE DECL
#xcommand FIRST => OUT(1) ;; #undef MODE ;; OUT(2)
FIRST
MODE

rows.name: declare
rows.source:
#xcommand DECLARE <!name!> <!class!> => #xcommand METHOD \<type:FUNCTION,PROCEDURE> <name> CLASS <class> => OUT(\<type>,"ok")
DECLARE New Test
METHOD FUNCTION New CLASS Test
